title: Attack in the Snow
summary: Sintel, hooded against the cold and carrying a staff, is alone in a white mountain landscape. A bald, bearded man attacks her and they grapple on the slope; she ends up lying on her back in the snow with a long pole across her body. A wide shot shows a small glowing light far away, then a staff with a round engraved end lies in the snow and the title SINTEL appears.
events: Sintel is alone in the snow with a staff
A bald man attacks her and they grapple
She ends up on her back in the snow
The title SINTEL appears
clues: A staff with a round engraved end
questionsRaised: Who is the bald man and why does he attack her?
What is the glowing light in the distance?

title: Firelit Tent
summary: Inside a round tent with a fire at its centre, an old man with a gray beard examines a staff that ends in a round metal cap. Sintel, in a sleeveless top, sits by the fire with him and is later seen holding a bowl of pale liquid.
events: The old man examines the staff
Sintel sits by the fire and holds a bowl of pale liquid
questionsRaised: How did Sintel get from the snow into the tent?

title: City of Rooftops
summary: A wide view of a huge city of crowded rooftops under a hazy sky, then a narrow sunlit alley where Sintel, now in a sleeveless top with short hair, is seen on a terrace.
events: Wide view over the city
Sintel in a sunlit alley and on a terrace
questionsRaised: What is Sintel doing in the city?

title: A Wounded Little Dragon
summary: Sintel hurries through the alleys and climbs onto a tiled roof. On a cobbled rooftop she finds a little winged creature with a bloodied wing and crouches near it. She holds out her hand and the creature looks at it. Later, in a cluttered room, she holds the little dragon in her lap with a hand on its head; blood is visible near its wing.
events: Sintel finds a little winged creature with a bloodied wing
She holds out her hand to it
She cradles it in her lap

title: Night in a Cluttered Room
summary: Hands settle a basket on a blanket in the dark. At night, someone lies asleep on a bed in a dark, cluttered room. The picture dissolves into warm light over fabric and a close view of the little dragon's scaly body beside a hand.
events: Night in the room, someone asleep on a bed
Dissolve to the little dragon's scaly body in warm light

title: Market Chase
summary: The little dragon dashes down a market alley with people hurrying behind it; chickens scatter and a figure leaps between buildings. Sintel then stands in the market with an alert look on her face.
events: The little dragon races through a market alley
Sintel in the market

title: Rooftops at Sunset
summary: The little dragon perches on a ledge with birds in the sky behind it, and Sintel smiles. She climbs a slanted tiled roof toward warm evening light and reaches a high ruined rooftop. At one point she laughs with her hands on her head. Several small winged creatures fly across the sunset sky above the rooftops while she watches.
events: The little dragon on a ledge
Sintel climbs a tiled roof
Winged creatures fly across the sunset

title: A Much Larger Dragon
summary: A much larger dragon with a long tail flies in near the little dragon above the rooftops. Sintel watches in alarm and reaches up toward a small dragon flying overhead. A pale, winged dragon with spread wings hovers over the rooftops. Afterwards Sintel stands alone among ruins, her expression hardening into anger.
events: A much larger dragon flies in
A pale dragon with spread wings hovers over the rooftops
Sintel alone among ruins, angry
questionsRaised: What happens to the little dragon?

title: A Long Journey
summary: Dissolving landscapes show a traveller crossing the world: a dusk plain of dead trees, a moonlit sky, a vast sand desert with a tiny figure, a dense bamboo forest, a rocky canyon at sunset where Sintel rests, a hooded traveller with a staff in misty mountains, and finally a snowy peak.
events: A tiny figure crosses a desert
Landscapes dissolve one into another

title: Back in the Snow
summary: In a snowy landscape a figure in a hooded coat lies in the snow with a long staff beside her, then a figure walks on through deep snow with a staff, footprints trailing behind.
events: A figure lies in the snow with a staff
She walks on through the snow

title: The Tent Again
summary: Back in the firelit tent, the old man and Sintel sit across from each other. Fingers rest on a round metal disc engraved with rings of symbols and a tree. The tree dissolves into a real tree on a dark hillside, and Sintel is seen on the dark hillside with a staff that has a bladed head.
events: A disc engraved with a tree
A lone tree on a dark hillside
clues: A tree engraved on a disc

title: Crystal Cave
summary: A moonlit cave mouth opens onto a cave lit by glowing crystals. Peering from behind rocks, Sintel sees an enormous dragon lying far across the cave. In close view, a grey dragon lowers its head over a raw red wound. Sintel watches from behind a rock, then climbs on with her spear.
events: Sintel sees an enormous dragon lying in the distance
A grey dragon over a raw red wound
clues: An enormous dragon in the crystal cave
questionsRaised: What is the enormous dragon doing?

title: Dragon in the Cave
summary: Sintel finds a young dragon curled asleep on a rock. Then the enormous dragon breathes a jet of fire across the cave. A fight follows: Sintel is brought down and crawls across the cave floor while the dragon looms over her with its claws, wings and head. She ends up gripping a dagger in both hands, her face tense.
events: A young dragon asleep on a rock
The enormous dragon breathes fire
Sintel fights the dragon and ends up gripping a dagger
clues: A young dragon asleep on a rock

title: The Dragon Falls
summary: The enormous dragon lies on the cave floor with a red pool spreading beneath its head while Sintel stands a few paces away, frightened. A close view of the dragon's head resting on the ground is followed by Sintel's red-tinted face.
events: The dragon lies on the cave floor
Sintel stands frightened beside it

title: Recognition and Grief
summary: Images of the places from Sintel's long journey flash behind her red-tinted face as she stares at the fallen dragon: this is Scales, the little dragon from the rooftops, grown up. Sintel reaches out an open hand toward it, as she once reached toward the little dragon in the sky, then stands by the fallen dragon, stricken.
events: Sintel realises the dragon is Scales
She reaches out an open hand
She stands over the fallen dragon
questionsResolved: Who is the enormous dragon? It is Scales.

title: After the Cave
summary: A bright cave opening, then a vast tree over a misty landscape with a tiny figure in the distance. Sintel sits alone on a cliff edge with her head bowed, then appears in close view, her face pained and tree roots behind her. She walks away across barren ground past white snowdrop flowers in the foreground. A small tan winged creature appears on the ground in the distance as the film ends.
events: Sintel sits alone on a cliff edge
Sintel walks away
A small winged creature appears on the ground
